$comment: MIGRATION VERSION RESERVATION REGISTRY (GOV-H, 2026-11-01).
A migration version is claimed REPOSITORY-WIDE, not per branch. The
uniqueness rule in scripts/check-migration-quality.js can only compare a new
migration with the files in the CURRENT checkout, so it is structurally blind
to a version claimed by a sibling branch and completely blind to one that
exists only as an uncommitted file in another worktree.
That blindness is not theoretical. THREE branches each claimed 20270110000000:
0d87637c  20270110000000_pi_prospect_problem_actor_fk_removal.sql  (PPO, PR #364, MERGED)
9f710167  20270110000000_canonical_leads_users_client_privileges_revoked.sql  (SEC-A)
9f359da0  20270110000000_media_h3_storage_quarantine_policies.sql  (media H-3)
At 9f710167 the tree held exactly ONE file at that version, so the gate
passed and the collision was invisible. It was resolved the right way: the
UNMERGED migrations were renumbered (SEC-A..SEC-B to 20270111000000-03, media
H-3 to 20270116000000) and the MERGED one kept its version. A migration
already applied to production is never renamed.
This registry is the durable half of the fix: a claim recorded here travels
with the repository, so any branch that rebases sees it and a second claim on
the same version fails the gate. The pre-integration half is
'node scripts/check-migration-quality.js --scan-refs', which enumerates every
branch tip AND every registered worktree's uncommitted on-disk files.
STATUS VALUES
occupied_elsewhere - the version is taken by work not in this checkout
(another branch, or an uncommitted file in a worktree).
A new migration using it FAILS the gate.
reserved           - allocated to a named track for a named slug. A file at
this version must use that slug.
merged             - the version is on origin/main. Recorded so it can never
be re-claimed or renumbered.
Remove an entry only when the version is on origin/main (then record it as
'merged') or the work was abandoned and the files deleted everywhere.

reservations.note: AMENDED 2026-11-21 (c6 draft, b3 ruling A; before any apply): THREE tables - salesnav_member_owner (PK member_id: one company per member, a second claim 23505), salesnav_member_bindings (RE-KEYED 2026-11-21 with a9: PK organization_id+user_id+transport, user_id uuid NOT NULL, one active member per company user and transport, a different member for an existing key is 409 account_binding_conflict, never a silent replace; composite FK member_id+organization_id to the owner row, so a binding cannot name another company member), salesnav_extraction_runs (closed status/code CHECK, closed_at iff terminal, seen_lead_keys keys-only bounded 10000, partial UNIQUE: one open run per member; vendor_cursor text NULL, CHECK NULL or transport IN (unipile, vayne) AND length <= 2000, so a cursor-paged run resumes after a daily-cap pause; browser transports page by next_page_index and keep it NULL). ALSO (b3 decision 3, 2026-11-21): active_route text NULL (extension|rpa; set iff transport is a browser route, for the automatic handoff; API transports NULL); refused gains reader_version_unsupported (contract v2.3: an outdated reader closes the run at once); pending_page_index + pending_granted integer NULL (both or neither; granted 0..25; page index = next_page_index when set) so POST /pages refuses leads beyond the cap reserved by POST /runs/:id/next. RLS on, one service_role policy each, zero client grants. Rollback refuses while 074 function exists. Was: One row per extraction run (tenant, transport, canonical member id, url kind + canonical URL, closed status set incl. resumable paused_daily_cap/auth_expired, next page, list_total, counts, retry_after_at, seen lead_key set: keys only, no person data) plus the per-transport company member binding (opaque canonical id only). RLS on, zero client grants, service_role only, postconditions prove the grant posture. Lands WITH its first caller (Unipile U3); nothing dormant. Apply is its own owner ask. PL-170 preconditions (LinkedIn UA legal review) to be confirmed by c6/b3 for this transport before any apply.
